## Description

Testate amoeba living inside a brown, dome-shaped organic test (~100 µm) of protein with iron and
manganese. Slow lobose pseudopods emerge through the aperture; it eats bacteria and algae; the test
protects it from other amoebae.

## In the simulation

<!-- GENERATED:presence -->
Drops: `moss` (weight 1.5), `pond` (weight 0.15), `puddle` (weight 0.15); 3 individuals in a reference drop at weight 1.
<!-- /GENERATED -->

`testate = "lobose"`: the soft body is the rigid test; pseudopods leave through the aperture, drag the
test and are drawn. It reproduces by pushing the daughter out of the aperture, which builds its own
test (modelled as budding). Speed estimated.

## Unique and shared mechanics

with yeasts and *Euglypha*.
